title: video-use: AI Agent Video Editing Toolkit
summary: An open-source framework that enables AI agents like Claude Code to perform automated video editing via natural language. It uses visual composites and structured metadata to guide FFmpeg for precise, token-efficient production.
research_notes: Optimized for terminal-based agents; features '12 hard rules' for professional-grade cuts and recently updated to support UTF-8 encoding and portrait orientation preservation.

evolution.summary: Evolved from a basic automation script into a specialized agent skill with local-first rendering, automated filler removal, and support for programmatic overlays via HyperFrames and Remotion.
